title: Input Attestation Verifier
description: Verify SPEC.md §23 input_attestations entries — vc-2.0, c2pa-manifest, rfc3161-snapshot, zktls — against a target artifact's policy_parameters. Reuses the §20 RFC 3161 verifier and §16 Data Integrity machinery; imports art-123's manifest structural check directly. Zero network.

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_input_attestations
mcp_tool_definition.description: Verify SPEC.md §23 input_attestations entries against a target artifact's policy_parameters. Resolves each entry's RFC 6901 pointer, binds its digest, and reports per-entry {pointer, type, structural, verifiable, freshness_status} across all four defined types (vc-2.0, c2pa-manifest, rfc3161-snapshot, zktls). rfc3161-snapshot reuses the same §20 RFC 3161 verifier; vc-2.0 reuses the §16 eddsa-jcs-2022 Data Integrity machinery; c2pa-manifest imports art-123's structural check; zktls is reported structural-only with verifiable:external, never OCG-confirmed. Zero network, no state change.
